scope: QualityBlock1990s facade residue geometry and the physical construction/exposure sources that can cause it
principle: Every generated weathering vertex must remain inside a physically defensible catchment from modeled construction, drainage, contact or exposure. Deterministic variation may change shape inside a catchment but may never invent a stain source.

windowSills.cause: rain exits discrete low points of a projecting sill/drip nose

rainwaterDownpipe.cause: concentrated repeated wetting/leakage/splash adjacent to the installed full-height drainage line

balconySlabLips.cause: rain exits one or two discrete low points on the slab drip edge

railBaseFixings.cause: localized coating failure at a mechanically anchored ferrous fixture can carry oxide residue downward
railBaseFixings.reasonForSparseRange: The generator intentionally limits visible oxide runoff to a minority of the 210 physical base plates so age does not become a repeated procedural motif.

acDrainHoses.cause: episodic condensate leaves a small dry mineral/dust deposit at the actual hose termination

gradeInterface.cause: soil/paving splash energy is height-limited and increases around concentrated downpipe discharge

groupBindingRules.Weathering_GradeSplash: Every vertex stays in the grade-interface envelope and the upper edge is measurably higher near the downpipe side than the far facade.
groupBindingRules.Weathering_RainRunoff: Every vertex is attributable to either one modeled sill catchment or the installed downpipe catchment; every sill and the downpipe must have witnesses.
groupBindingRules.Weathering_BalconyDrip: Every vertex is below and laterally inside a modeled slab-lip catchment; every slab lip must have witnesses.
groupBindingRules.Weathering_RailRust: Every vertex is attributable to a modeled rail base fixing; the active fixing set must remain sparse rather than covering all fixtures.
groupBindingRules.Weathering_ACResidue: Every vertex is within the horizontal termination patch of a modeled AC drain hose; every hose termination must have witnesses.

manualChecks: stains read as consequences of visible construction and exposure rather than arbitrary procedural decoration
rain streaks terminate beneath plausible drip origins and do not float beside openings
grade splash decays upward and strengthens locally near concentrated drainage without becoming a horizontal painted band
rail rust remains sparse and does not repeat at an immediately obvious cadence
AC residue remains a dry local termination deposit rather than a puddle or glossy wet patch
no catchment-compliant geometry is nevertheless visibly interpenetrating, z-fighting or compositionally implausible
